evidence.title: Welcome to Superconductor
evidence.finding: Shared cloud implementations support team conversations across clients.

evidence.title: Superconductor pricing
evidence.finding: Compute-based plans include member/concurrency allowances and BYOS; Pro has assisted rollout.

evidence.title: Ticket
evidence.finding: Native tickets own implementations; drafts are device-local; merged upstream branches retarget downstream tickets.

evidence.title: Diff & Guided Review
evidence.finding: Agent-guided file ordering and inline commentary supplement diffs and artifacts.

evidence.title: Usage
evidence.finding: Metered API spend is distinguished from hypothetical token value of subscription-covered work.

evidence.title: Introducing: Superconductor desktop app
evidence.locator: June 8, 2026; Windows support is coming soon
evidence.finding: The June launch post announces available macOS and Linux desktop apps and future Windows support without a target date.

evidence.title: Download Superconductor
evidence.finding: Current official download page lists macOS and Linux packages and marks Windows coming soon.

evidence.title: Overview | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Cloud agents are accessible through browser/desktop/mobile clients and shared multiplayer workspaces.

evidence.title: Desktop apps | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: macOS 13+ Intel/ARM and Linux AppImage/deb clients; Windows coming soon; desktop push not yet available.

evidence.title: Mobile apps | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Native iOS/iPad app supports tickets, chat, diffs and PRs. Android uses a PWA, with opt-in browser/mobile push.

evidence.title: Agents | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Pi, Muse Code, OpenCode, Amp and Factory Droid run in cloud environments.

evidence.title: Agent credentials | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Subscriptions and API keys are separate routes. Connected-plan quota exhaustion stops work without automatic API fallback.

evidence.title: Superconductor API | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: PAT API reads project tickets/chats/diffs, creates tickets with optional default-agent launch and sends messages; existing-ticket launch and PR creation are not available.

evidence.title: Skills and MCPs | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Project-scoped MCP connectors, Playwright and repository skills are configured for agents.

evidence.title: Connectors | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Personal/workspace connectors inherit external permissions and project sharing; custom MCP is supported.

evidence.title: Superconductor skills | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Agents read project ticket/chat/diff records and create tickets with optional default-agent launch. They cannot change existing tickets or read saved artifacts.

evidence.title: Quick start | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Connect repositories, provider credentials and a development environment before launching a ticket.

evidence.title: Tickets | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Native tickets have states and multiple implementations, searchable dashboards, stars and local drafts; implementation picker launches up to twelve per action.

evidence.title: Implementations | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Independent implementations receive separate branches/environments, explicit status, estimated costs and PR create/update actions.

evidence.title: Chat | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Workspace collaborators share chat, presence and inputs. Claude supports mid-turn steering; others queue. Model changes apply to later turns within a harness.

evidence.title: Diff & Guided Review | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Full/uncommitted diffs, anchored comments, Guided Review and changes-requested follow-ups are documented.

evidence.title: QA Checks [Beta] | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Private-beta QA agent checks ticket requirements, code quality and tests; not a generally available gate.

evidence.title: Artifacts | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Images, documents, recordings and files are saved with implementations and have viewers.

evidence.title: Development environment | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Automatic setup configures packages/build/start commands and previews; snapshots and encrypted/redacted environment secrets are documented.

evidence.title: Lifecycle | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Cloud environments retain files while idle-paused but not processes. Startup commands rerun; failed snapshot builds retain last successful snapshot.

evidence.title: Network sandboxing | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Network allowlists have provider/platform exceptions. Users can allow blocked paths for a ticket/chat or project; next run uses the new rules.

evidence.title: Automations | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Recurring schedules and merged-PR events create tickets, launch runs or send messages; event duplication is suppressed and throttling is configurable.

evidence.title: Workspaces | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Owner/Admin/Collaborator/Viewer permissions, membership and a recent-activity sidebar are documented; model credits differ from compute credits.

evidence.title: Usage | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Dashboard separates actual metered API spend from token-equivalent value, with user/agent breakdowns and subscription coverage.

evidence.title: Pricing | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: Free $0 uses a one-time 20000-credit grant; Pro starts at $50 monthly. Compute is per-second credit usage; seats are not separately billed.

evidence.title: Security | Superconductor Docs
evidence.finding: AWS hosting, encrypted sensitive data, RBAC, aggregate telemetry and 30-day account-closure deletion are stated. SOC 2 Type 2 is a goal, not an achieved assurance.
